correctness.rationale: Every nonempty independent subset of complete multipartite K_(n_1,...,n_r), r>=2, lies in exactly one part. Every vertex in another part sees precisely |S| neighbors of S; those in its own part see zero. Therefore such S is odd-independent iff |S| is odd. Summing binomial coefficients yields I_od(x)=1+Σ_i Σ_(j odd) binom(n_i,j)x^j and the maximum is the greatest odd integer <= max_i n_i, giving equality with alpha(G) precisely when max_i n_i is odd. Independent exhaustive direct-definition replay at (2,3,4) yields counts {0:1,1:9,3:5}, maximum3; general proof exact.

evidence: The proposition on bipartite odd degrees gives exact equality for regular bipartite graphs of odd degree, not irregular multipartite families.
The new polynomial counts odd-independent sets at every size, more than merely bounding their maximum.
